_meta.title: The Clairs — the receptive side of the 6-Sense Protocol
_meta.principle: Every channel has an outward instrument (fork, oil, tea, breath, color, field) and an inward Clair. The tone that tunes a channel is the tone that clears its Clair. Correspondences are traditional associations; the person's own experience is the only evidence. A Clair has a polarity state like any signal and obeys never-amplify.
_meta.framing: The Clairs are perceptual faculties described across the esoteric tradition. A tone does not grant a faculty; a calibration does not contact anyone or anything. Perception is first-person by nature.

clairs.name: Clairvoyance
clairs.opens: Inner vision: images, symbols, color, the aura seen with the mind's eye.
clairs.inExcess: Images that will not stop; the dream bleeding into the day. Met with Saturn, the boundary tone, not more Neptune.
clairs.whenDeficient: A door not yet opened. Activated directly with its own tones.

clairs.name: Clairaudience
clairs.opens: Inner hearing: words, tones, music with no outer source. The struck fork is the door.
clairs.inExcess: Noise with no off switch. Grounded with the Earth Year tone at the sternum.
clairs.whenDeficient: Listen to the fade after the strike. The silence after the tone is part of the tone.

clairs.name: Clairsentience
clairs.opens: The feeling body: energy and emotion sensed as physical sensation. Gut feeling, made literal.
clairs.inExcess: Feeling everything, holding nothing. Met with Saturn: structure, edge, bone.
clairs.whenDeficient: The Sun at the solar plexus steadies the seat of feeling.

clairs.name: Claircognizance
clairs.opens: Direct knowing: the flash that arrives whole, without steps. Uranus is the lightning; Jupiter is the wide view it lands in.
clairs.inExcess: Certainty running ahead of the body. Grounded with Earth Day at the root.
clairs.whenDeficient: The knowing you keep talking yourself out of. Resourced, never forced.

clairs.name: Clairalience
clairs.opens: Scent with no source: the memory-sense, the oldest door. Venus rules the pleasure senses; Earth Day keeps the animal nose in the body.
clairs.inExcess: Scents that crowd the room. Earth Day brings it back to the floor.
clairs.whenDeficient: Diffuse the carrier's oil and let the nose lead.

clairs.name: Clairgustance
clairs.opens: Taste with nothing on the tongue: the signature taken inward. The tea is the outward instrument; this is what it may open.
clairs.inExcess: A taste that lingers past its welcome. The Earth Year tone settles the vagal line.
clairs.whenDeficient: Sip slowly. Taste is the slowest sense to wake.

clairs.name: Clairtangency
clairs.opens: Reading through contact: the history held in matter. A weighted fork on bone is touch; Saturn rules bone, matter, and time.
clairs.inExcess: Every object speaks at once. Earth Day quiets the room.
clairs.whenDeficient: Hold the fork stem to the point and stay there. Two strikes, then let it fade.

clairs.name: Clairempathy
clairs.opens: Feeling another's state as your own, through the field. The most generous Clair and the one most in need of an edge.
clairs.inExcess: Absorbing every room you walk into. Never amplified with more Moon and Neptune: met with Saturn, the boundary tone.
clairs.whenDeficient: Open and boundaried at once is the goal. Balanced means both.
